definition swap_list:
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))

    type:

Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition swap_list (xs : list Z) (i j : nat) : list Z :=
  match xs !! i, xs !! j with
  | Some xi, Some xj => <[i := xj]> (<[j := xi]> xs)
  | _, _ => xs
  end.

lomuto

cjr.examples.qsort.lomuto

recursive function lomuto:
    parameter(n, type(nat))
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(pivot, type(Z))
    parameter(i, j, bound, type(nat))
    type:
        product_type(list(Z), nat)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            n
            case:
                patterns(O)
                tuple_with_tail_items(xs, items(i))
            case:
                patterns(S(n))
                if_then_else:
                    Nat.ltb(j, bound)
                    match RegularStyle:
                        lookup(xs, j)
                        case:
                            patterns(Some(v))
                            if_then_else:
                                Z.leb(v, pivot)
                                lomuto(n, swap_list(xs, i, j), pivot, S(i), S(j), bound)
                                lomuto(n, xs, pivot, i, S(j), bound)
                        case:
                            patterns(None)
                            tuple_with_tail_items(xs, items(i))
                    tuple_with_tail_items(xs, items(i))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint lomuto (n : nat) (xs : list Z) (pivot : Z) (i j bound : nat)
  : list Z * nat :=
  match n with
  | O => (xs, i)
  | S n =>
      if Nat.ltb j bound then
        match xs !! j with
        | Some v =>
            if Z.leb v pivot then
              lomuto n (swap_list xs i j) pivot (S i) (S j) bound
            else lomuto n xs pivot i (S j) bound
        | None => (xs, i)
        end
      else (xs, i)
  end.

definition partition_list:
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(lo, hi, type(nat))
    type:
        product_type(list(Z), nat)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            lookup(xs, in_scope nat(subtract(hi, 1)))
            case:
                patterns(Some(pivot))
                match RegularStyle:
                    lomuto:
                        in_scope nat(subtract(subtract(hi, 1), lo))
                        xs
                        pivot
                        lo
                        lo
                        in_scope nat(subtract(hi, 1))
                    case:
                        patterns(tuple_with_tail_items(zs, items(q)))
                        tuple_with_tail_items:
                            swap_list(zs, q, in_scope nat(subtract(hi, 1)))
                            items(q)
            case:
                patterns(None)
                tuple_with_tail_items(xs, items(lo))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition partition_list (xs : list Z) (lo hi : nat) : list Z * nat :=
  match xs !! (hi - 1)%nat with
  | Some pivot =>
      match lomuto ((hi - 1) - lo)%nat xs pivot lo lo (hi - 1)%nat with
      | (zs, q) => (swap_list zs q (hi - 1)%nat, q)
      end
  | None => (xs, lo)
  end.

qsort_slice

cjr.examples.qsort.qsort_slice

recursive function qsort_slice:
    parameter(n, type(nat))
    parameter(xs, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(lo, hi, type(nat))
    type:
        list(Z)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            n
            case:
                patterns(O)
                xs
            case:
                patterns(S(n))
                if_then_else:
                    Nat.leb(hi, in_scope nat(add(lo, 1)))
                    xs
                    match LetPatternStyle:
                        partition_list(xs, lo, hi)
                        case:
                            patterns(tuple_with_tail_items(ys, items(p)))
                            qsort_slice(n, qsort_slice(n, ys, lo, p), S(p), hi)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint qsort_slice (n : nat) (xs : list Z) (lo hi : nat) : list Z :=
  match n with
  | O => xs
  | S n =>
      if Nat.leb hi (lo + 1)%nat then xs
      else
        let '(ys, p) := partition_list xs lo hi in
        qsort_slice n (qsort_slice n ys lo p) (S p) hi
  end.

Definition slice_sorted (xs : list Z) (lo hi : nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j x y, (lo ≤ i)%nat → (i < j)%nat → (j < hi)%nat →
    xs !! i = Some x → xs !! j = Some y → (x ≤ y)%Z.

Lemma swap_lookup xs i j xi xj k :
  xs !! i = Some xi → xs !! j = Some xj →
  swap_list xs i j !! k =
    if decide (k = i) then Some xj
    else if decide (k = j) then Some xi else xs !! k.

Lemma count_insert xs i y x z :
  xs !! i = Some y →
  count_occ Z.eq_dec (<[i:=x]> xs) z + (if Z.eq_dec z y then 1 else 0)
    = count_occ Z.eq_dec xs z + (if Z.eq_dec z x then 1 else 0).

Lemma take_lookup_eq (xs ys : list Z) n :
  (n ≤ length xs)%nat → (n ≤ length ys)%nat →
  (∀ k, (k < n)%nat → xs !! k = ys !! k) →
  take n xs = take n ys.

Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint count_if (P : Z → bool) (xs : list Z) : nat :=
  match xs with
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => (if P x then 1%nat else 0%nat) + count_if P xs
  end.

region_count

cjr.examples.qsort.region_count

lemma region_count:
    parameter(P, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(xs, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(lo, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(hi, type(_ (inferred)))
    statement:
        arrow:
            in_scope nat(less_or_equal(lo, hi))
            arrow:
                in_scope nat(less_or_equal(hi, length(xs)))
                equals:
                    count_if(P, xs)
                    in_scope nat:
                        add:
                            add:
                                count_if(P, take(lo, xs))
                                count_if(P, take(subtract(hi, lo), drop(lo, xs)))
                            count_if(P, drop(hi, xs))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma region_count P xs lo hi :
  (lo ≤ hi)%nat → (hi ≤ length xs)%nat →
  count_if P xs =
    (count_if P (take lo xs) +
     count_if P (take (hi - lo) (drop lo xs)) +
     count_if P (drop hi xs))%nat.

  (lo ≤ hi ≤ length xs)%nat →
  (∀ k x, (lo ≤ k < hi)%nat → xs !! k = Some x → P x = false) →
  count_if P (take (hi - lo) (drop lo xs)) = 0%nat.

Lemma region_preserved (P : Z → bool) (xs ys : list Z) (lo hi : nat) :
  length ys = length xs →
  (lo ≤ hi ≤ length xs)%nat →
  (∀ k, (k < lo ∨ hi ≤ k)%nat → ys !! k = xs !! k) →
  ys ≡ₚ xs →
  (∀ k x, (lo ≤ k < hi)%nat → xs !! k = Some x → P x = true) →
  ∀ k x, (lo ≤ k < hi)%nat → ys !! k = Some x → P x = true.

Record lomuto_inv (xs0 xs : list Z) (lo i j bound : nat) (pivot : Z) : Prop := {
  linv_len : length xs = length xs0;
  linv_perm : xs ≡ₚ xs0;
  linv_lo : (lo ≤ i)%nat;
  linv_ij : (i ≤ j)%nat;

Definition scan_body (a : val) (pivot : Z) (li lj : loc) : expr :=
    call2 get_body (Val a) (sload lj) "v"
      (Let None
        (If (BinOp LeOp (Var "v") (Val (zval pivot)))
          (Let None (call3 swap_body (Val a) (sload li) (sload lj))
            (sset li (plus1 (sload li))))
          unitv)
        (sset lj (plus1 (sload lj)))).

Lemma wp_scan_body g xs (a : val) (pivot v xi : Z) (i j : nat) (li lj : loc) Φ :
    rigid a →
    xs !! i = Some xi →
    xs !! j = Some v →
    StackId li ↦ₛ nval i -∗
    StackId lj ↦ₛ nval j -∗
    R g xs a -∗
    (∀ xs' (i' : nat),
      ⌜if bool_decide (v ≤ pivot)%Z
       then xs' = swap_list xs i j ∧ i' = S i
       else xs' = xs ∧ i' = i⌝ -∗
      StackId li ↦ₛ nval i' -∗
      StackId lj ↦ₛ nval (S j) -∗
      R g xs' a -∗ Φ (LitV LitUnit)) -∗
    WP scan_body a pivot li lj {{ Φ }}.
